claim_text: Iron requirements increase during pregnancy, but an additional iron supplement should not be layered onto prenatal products without reviewing elemental iron exposure, antenatal policy and clinical/laboratory context.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support context-specific safety assessment and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: Pregnant people using or considering prenatal supplements.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and/or supplemental products; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron Health Professional Fact Sheet provides pregnancy reference information and safety context.
limitations: Reference intake is not automatically a separate supplemental dose; local antenatal protocols vary.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
